Contract GenerateLoanLetterAndAgreementModule::createLoanAccount(loanaccountid:Integer,balance:Real,status:LoanAccountStatus[NORMAL|HASPAIDINFULL]): Boolean {
          definition:
          loanAccount:LoanAccount = LoanAccount.allInstance()->any(o | o.LoanAccountID = loanaccountid)
            
            precondition:
          loanAccount.oclIsUndefined() or loanAccount.oclIsTypeOf(LoanAccount)
            
            postcondition:
          let newLoanAccount:LoanAccount in newLoanAccount.oclIsNew() and LoanAccount.allInstance()->includes(newLoanAccount) and newLoanAccount.LoanAccountID = loanaccountid and newLoanAccount.Balance = balance and newLoanAccount.Status = status and (loanAccount.oclIsUndefined() implies (result = true)) and (not loanAccount.oclIsUndefined() implies (result = false))
            
        }
